scope: Durable SEN chat recovery: sessions, turns, attempts, sequenced events, command receipts, checkpoints on the promoted SQLite interfaces.

evidenceLevels.fixture: executed against a synthetic SQLite store reconstructed from chat-contract.json
evidenceLevels.live-promoted: executed copy-first against the real promoted DBs in go/internal/localdb
evidenceLevels.pending-lane1: requires the canonical Lane 1 chat store/schema; not landed at generation time

cells.injection: begin turn+events insert, roll back before commit (simulated writer crash mid-transaction)
cells.invariant: atomicity: no partial turn or orphan events visible after reopen
cells.expected: zero rows from the aborted transaction; session version unchanged

cells.injection: commit turn+receipt, then drop the ack; client retries with the same commandId
cells.expected: replay returns the original receipt; exactly one turn row for the commandId

cells.injection: send the same commandId twice (network retry), both acked
cells.expected: second send replays receipt; turn count for commandId stays 1; receipts identical

cells.injection: refetch an event tail overlapping already-applied seqs (reconnect overlap)
cells.expected: mergeEventsBySeq yields each seq exactly once, strictly ordered

cells.injection: delete one middle event from the delivered stream
cells.expected: hasEventGap reports true at the missing seq; refetch from after_seq restores continuity

cells.injection: leave committed frames in the WAL (no checkpoint), then copy-first inspect
cells.invariant: copy preserves committed state; WAL+SHM travel with the copy
cells.expected: copied DB reads all committed rows; integrity_check ok on the copy

cells.injection: run the copy-first inspector against a live promoted DB
cells.invariant: read-only inspection never mutates the source (Sprint 02 debt: gate inspection created empty WAL/SHM sidecars)
cells.expected: source byte hash unchanged; zero new sidecar files beside the source DB

cells.injection: worker crash leaving an attempt in running with a stale leaseOwner
cells.invariant: attempt-lease: a higher lease generation may fence and reclaim; single-writer preserved
cells.expected: reclaim with generation+1 succeeds; old owner write is rejected; no duplicate turn_seq

cells.injection: second process opens the same store and writes while the first writer holds it
cells.invariant: single-writer (SQLITE_BUSY or lease rejection, never silent interleave)
cells.expected: no interleaved commit; busy_timeout surfaced as an error, data stays consistent

cells.injection: Go listener unconfigured/unreachable while legacy flag is off
cells.invariant: fail-closed: proxy answers 503 offline; never silently dual-writes to legacy
cells.expected: POST/GET return 503 with the offline error; PATCH/DELETE return 501
cells.note: Static contract confirmed in src/app/api/sen/chat/route.ts; runtime probe needs a configured listener
